§aAnvils§k§f are a quicker and cheaper way to forge metal parts for your tools.

The Forging mechanic is similar to §6TerraFirmaCraft,§f and to work metals you have to;

- Heat them up in a Charcoal/Brick Oven till it says "§6Workable§f"
- Put the ingot of metal in the §6Anvil§f along with a hammer and try to match the 3 criteria of the tool part as well as keeping the arrows synchronized with each other
